import heapq

class mcf_graph_int_cost:

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.pos = []
        self.g = [[] for _ in range(n)]


    def add_edge(self, from_, to, cap, cost):
        # assert 0 <= from_ < self.n
        # assert 0 <= to < self.n
        m = len(self.pos)
        self.pos.append((from_, len(self.g[from_])))
        self.g[from_].append(self.__class__._edge(to, len(self.g[to]), cap, cost))
        self.g[to].append(self.__class__._edge(from_, len(self.g[from_]) - 1, 0, -cost))
        return m


    class edge:
        def __init__(self, from_, to, cap, flow, cost):
            self.from_ = from_
            self.to = to
            self.cap = cap
            self.flow = flow
            self.cost = cost


    def get_edge(self, i):
        _e = self.g[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
        _re = self.g[_e.to][_e.rev]
        return self.__class__.edge(self.pos[i][0], _e.to, _e.cap + _re.cap, _re.cap, _e.cost)


    def edges(self):
        ret = []
        for i in range(len(self.pos)):
            _e = self.g[self.pos[i][0]][self.pos[i][1]]
            _re = self.g[_e.to][_e.rev]
            ret.append(self.__class__.edge(self.pos[i][0], _e.to, _e.cap + _re.cap, _re.cap, _e.cost))
        return ret


    def _dual_ref(self, s, t):
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.n
        self.pv = [-1] * self.n
        self.pe = [-1] * self.n
        self.vis = [False] * self.n

        que = [s] # s ==  (0 << 32) + s 
        self.dist[s] = 0
        while que:
            v = heapq.heappop(que) & 4294967295
            if self.vis[v]:
                continue
            self.vis[v] = True
            if v == t:
                break
            for i in range(len(self.g[v])):
                e = self.g[v][i]
                if self.vis[e.to] or e.cap == 0:
                    continue
                cost = e.cost - self.dual[e.to] + self.dual[v]
                if self.dist[e.to] > self.dist[v] + cost:
                    self.dist[e.to] = self.dist[v] + cost
                    self.pv[e.to] = v
                    self.pe[e.to] = i
                    heapq.heappush(que, ((self.dist[e.to] << 32) + e.to))
        if not self.vis[t]:
            return False

        for v in range(self.n):
            if not self.vis[v]:
                continue
            self.dual[v] -= self.dist[t] - self.dist[v]
        
        return True


    def slope(self, s, t, flow_limit=4294967295):
        # assert 0 <= s < self.n
        # assert 0 <= t < self.n
        # assert s != t
        
        self.dual = [0] * self.n
        self.dist = [4294967295] * self.n
        self.pv = [-1] * self.n
        self.pe = [-1] * self.n
        self.vis = [False] * self.n
        
        flow = 0
        cost = 0
        prev_cost = -1
        result = [(flow, cost)]
        while flow < flow_limit:
            if not self._dual_ref(s, t):
                break
            c = flow_limit - flow
            v = t
            while v != s:
                c = min(c, self.g[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]].cap)
                v = self.pv[v]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.g[self.pv[v]][self.pe[v]]
                e.cap -= c
                self.g[v][e.rev].cap += c
                v = self.pv[v]
            d = -self.dual[s]
            flow += c
            cost += c * d
            if prev_cost == d:
                result.pop()
            result.append((flow, cost))
            prev_cost = cost
        return result


    def flow(self, s, t, flow_limit=4294967295):
        return self.slope(s, t, flow_limit)[-1]

        def __init__(self, to, rev, cap, cost):
            self.to = to
            self.rev = rev
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost

import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class McfGraphIntCost {
        int n;
        List<int[]> pos;
        List<List<_Edge>> g;

        public McfGraphIntCost(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            this.pos = new ArrayList<>();
            this.g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                this.g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        public int addEdge(int from, int to, long cap, long cost) {
            int m = pos.size();
            pos.add(new int[]{from, g.get(from).size()});
            g.get(from).add(new _Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap, cost));
            g.get(to).add(new _Edge(from, g.get(from).size() - 1, 0, -cost));
            return m;
        }

        public Edge getEdge(int i) {
            int[] p = pos.get(i);
            _Edge e = g.get(p[0]).get(p[1]);
            _Edge re = g.get(e.to).get(e.rev);
            return new Edge(p[0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost);
        }

        public List<Edge> edges() {
            List<Edge> ret = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < pos.size(); i++) {
                int[] p = pos.get(i);
                _Edge e = g.get(p[0]).get(p[1]);
                _Edge re = g.get(e.to).get(e.rev);
                ret.add(new Edge(p[0], e.to, e.cap + re.cap, re.cap, e.cost));
            }
            return ret;
        }

        long[] dist;
        int[] pv;
        int[] pe;
        boolean[] vis;
        long[] dual;

        private boolean _dualRef(int s, int t) {
            dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, 4294967295L);
            pv = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pv, -1);
            pe = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(pe, -1);
            vis = new boolean[n];

            PriorityQueue<Long> que = new PriorityQueue<>();
            que.add((0L << 32) | s);
            dist[s] = 0;
            while (!que.isEmpty()) {
                long vPacked = que.poll();
                int v = (int)(vPacked & 0xFFFFFFFFL);
                if (vis[v]) continue;
                vis[v] = true;
                if (v == t) break;
                List<_Edge> edges = g.get(v);
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    _Edge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (vis[e.to] || e.cap == 0) continue;
                    long cost = e.cost - dual[e.to] + dual[v];
                    if (dist[e.to] > dist[v] + cost) {
                        dist[e.to] = dist[v] + cost;
                        pv[e.to] = v;
                        pe[e.to] = i;
                        que.add((dist[e.to] << 32) | e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!vis[t]) return false;

            for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
                if (!vis[v]) continue;
                dual[v] -= (dist[t] - dist[v]);
            }
            return true;
        }

        public List<long[]> slope(int s, int t, long flowLimit) {
            dual = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            pv = new int[n];
            pe = new int[n];
            vis = new boolean[n];

            long flow = 0;
            long cost = 0;
            long prevCost = -1;
            List<long[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
            result.add(new long[]{flow, cost});

            while (flow < flowLimit) {
                if (!_dualRef(s, t)) break;
                long c = flowLimit - flow;
                int v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    c = Math.min(c, g.get(pv[v]).get(pe[v]).cap);
                    v = pv[v];
                }
                v = t;
                while (v != s) {
                    _Edge e = g.get(pv[v]).get(pe[v]);
                    e.cap -= c;
                    g.get(v).get(e.rev).cap += c;
                    v = pv[v];
                }
                long d = -dual[s];
                flow += c;
                cost += c * d;
                if (prevCost == d) {
                    result.remove(result.size() - 1);
                }
                result.add(new long[]{flow, cost});
                prevCost = cost;
            }
            return result;
        }

        public long[] flow(int s, int t) {
            return flow(s, t, 4294967295L);
        }

        public long[] flow(int s, int t, long flowLimit) {
            List<long[]> res = slope(s, t, flowLimit);
            return res.get(res.size() - 1);
        }

        static class _Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long cap, cost;
            _Edge(int to, int rev, long cap, long cost) {
                this.to = to; this.rev = rev; this.cap = cap; this.cost = cost;
            }
        }

        static class Edge {
            int from, to;
            long cap, flow, cost;
            Edge(int from, int to, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
                this.from = from; this.to = to; this.cap = cap; this.flow = flow; this.cost = cost;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNext()) return;
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long a1 = sc.nextLong(), a2 = sc.nextLong(), a3 = sc.nextLong();
        long b1 = sc.nextLong(), b2 = sc.nextLong(), b3 = sc.nextLong();

        McfGraphIntCost g = new McfGraphIntCost(8);
        g.addEdge(0, 1, a1, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 2, a2, 0);
        g.addEdge(0, 3, a3, 0);
        g.addEdge(4, 7, b1, 0);
        g.addEdge(5, 7, b2, 0);
        g.addEdge(6, 7, b3, 0);
        long INF = 1000000000L;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            for (int j = 4; j <= 6; j++) {
                long cost = ((j - i) % 3 == 1) ? 1 : 0;
                g.addEdge(i, j, INF, cost);
            }
        }

        long[] fAns = g.flow(0, 7);
        long ans1 = fAns[1];
        long ans2 = Math.min(a1, b2) + Math.min(a2, b3) + Math.min(a3, b1);
        System.out.println(ans1 + " " + ans2);
    }
}
